== Summary ==

{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}

Rand, [[Rhuarc]], and the other Jindo begin to jog toward [[Cold Rocks Hold]]. [[Amys]] joins them, but the rest of the [[Wise One]]s, along with [[Moiraine]] and [[Egwene]], continue at a normal pace. [[Couladin]] joins the group and then [[Mat]] does, too. They approach [[Lian]], the roofmistress of Cold Rocks Hold to give and receive greetings. Rhuarc and Heirn ask leave to enter, which is granted. Then Couladin asks, but as a clan chief (which he is not) and receives a bare welcome. Couladin stalks off angrily; Aviendha explains that he has been welcomed only as a beggar; Lian has insulted him, but carefully not included the rest of the Shaido in her insult. Rand asks leave to come inside, but he is flustered and accidentally echoes Heirn's lesser request, not Rhuarc's clan chief phrasing. Lian is pleased with his humility, but gives her welcome to the ''[[Car'a'carn]]''.

Rhuarc puts his arms around Amys and Lian and introduces Rand to Amys as the wife he has met and Lian as the wife he hasn't. Rand hadn't really grasped that some Aiel had two wives, thinking he had surely misunderstood. Mat is even more flustered than Rand, but Rand apologizes, clarifying that Aviendha ''has'' been teaching him but he had missed this part; it is his fault, nuot hers.

They enjoy a pleasant meal of a crumbly, course yellow cake {{ref|Cornbread.}}; a spicy stew of goat meat and peppers; ''zemai'' and ''t'mat'' {{ref|Corn and tomatoes.}}; long red beans mixed in with green beans; and a sweet fruit called a ''kardon'' {{ref|Prickly pears}}. [[Aviendha]] continues to lecture Rand about everything, saying that she must forgo the meal in order to continue. Rand resolves to give her a gift which he hopes will reduce the sharpness of her tongue. Rhuarc informs Rand that several clan chiefs have already arrived at the meeting place, [[Alcair Dal]], or are on their way.

Rand wonders if he should go soon to the meeting, to make sure the clans do not continue with whatever blood-feuds they have. Rhuarc recommends against that since those not present will lose honor when the ''Car'a'carn'' is presented. Rand leaves the conference to go out for a walk.
